current.text: Jaylen Brown is gone from Boston. Jayson Tatum and Paul George are on the team, and George is the clear number two option behind Tatum.
Experts expect his usage to drop because he moves from second option to third behind Tatum and George. He likely plays under 34 minutes.
Both projected Boston starting fives include him.
He has played his first preseason game.
Experts expect his shooting percentages to improve this season, with more catch-and-shoot looks next to Tatum and George, who share the ball more than Brown did.
Experts expect lower usage, less time on the ball and age to offset better shooting, so they see little overall improvement.
In category leagues experts value him around 40 to 50 overall, a round 4 player. Picks 31 to 36 are called too early.
ESPN's rank of 16 to 18 and a Fantrax ADP of 34 make him a bust at that price. He is more likely to fall short of it than to reach it.
In auctions, an expert values him in the mid 20s USD. He went for 14 USD in a mock, which the expert called a steal.
Boston has 16 back-to-backs, tied for the most in the league. Three of them fall in our playoff window. The extra rest risk mainly affects Paul George and Mitchell Robinson.
Boston's playoff schedule for a March 28 end is 4-3-4, one game short of the maximum.
Experts see Boston as better than last season. One predicts 48 wins.

durable.text: His blocks are far above other guards.
Experts call him an excellent steals and blocks player.
His projected FG% of about 41% on about 14 attempts a game clearly hurts a team's FG%.
Besides blocks, his category strengths are threes and assists. His FT% is high, but the low volume means it moves a team's FT% only a little.
He is much better in category leagues than in points leagues.

note: White is a strong 3PM, AST and guard-BLK source, and he plays nearly every game. His roughly 41% FG on 14 attempts makes him a natural fit for punt FG%. Experts see him around 40 to 50 in categories and value him in the mid 20s USD, so 30 USD (his price in our league last season) or ESPN's 42 USD value is too much. Yahoo's 25 USD value and an average cost near 13 to 20 USD is the range to target. Early in the season, check whether his FG% recovers and whether lower usage behind Tatum and George pushes his minutes under 34.
